title: The Educational Role of the Masjid in Islam

text_simplified: The masjid in Islam is not merely a place for prayer; it is a comprehensive social tarbiyah (upbringing) institution. The Prophet ﷺ used the masjid for teaching, guidance, military training, and resolving disputes. It was also a center for social care, receiving delegations, and conducting marriages. Thus, the masjid plays a vital tarbiyah role in shaping the social behavior of individuals and the community.
